Es erzeugt eine Erklärung zur Barrierefr: It builds an accessibility statement from your details (conformity level as self-assessment, date, contact, enforcement body) and outputs it via shortcode on a page. It also checks the stored content of up to 20 published pages, posts and products for three patterns. The pattern check does not replace an assessment of the website against WCAG or EN 301 549, and the plugin does not judge whether or how the BFSG applies to your service.
